evidence_against.relevance: Casey regularly initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Casey invested time in Drew's important interview preparation and attended a birthday dinner Drew considered important.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods of geographic separation.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it, supporting a low-commitment interpretation.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled two advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could state the level of commitment and planning desired and ask whether Casey is willing to offer it, given the combination of consistent contact and repeated limits on definition and future planning.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's sustained initiation, practical support, and resumed contact show meaningful interest, but the repeated refusal to define the relationship, convenience-oriented planning, cancellations, and resistance to longer-term or socially integrated involvement more strongly support B.
